unit.why: A short anecdote: on the Maggid's first visit, the Besht has him honoured and reveals that his father R. Yitzhak of Drohobych raised a lowly soul to the level of Rashbi. The anecdote is followed by a homiletic comment from Agra de-Pirka.

stories.start_quote: סיפרו לי מגידי אמת ששמעו מכבוד
stories.end_quote: להגבי' נשמתו עדי אין ערך והבן
stories.summary_en: When the Maggid R. Yehiel Michel first came to the Besht, the Besht had him honoured and told those present that his father, R. Yitzhak of Drohobych, had been given one of the smallest souls of the generation and raised it to the level of R. Shimon bar Yohai. The author then draws the lesson that a person's deeds can elevate his soul.
